About the Firm

Trusted counsel, since 1983

For over four decades, Aldridge & Pryce has provided expert legal advice to individuals and businesses across Greater Manchester. Founded by Catherine Aldridge and James Pryce, the firm combines deep specialist expertise with a genuinely personal service that larger firms struggle to replicate.

We believe exceptional legal advice demands more than technical knowledge. It requires understanding — of your situation, your objectives, and the human context behind every instruction. Our clients value our directness, our availability, and our commitment to achieving the best possible outcome.

“What sets the firm apart is the rare ability to combine deep legal expertise with an incredibly personal touch.”

— Chambers UK
